'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[Kachin conflict]]
***The [[Kachin Independence Army]] says that it attacked a police station in Kyaukgyi village-tract in Shwegu Township, [[Kachin State]], injuring at least one officer. They claim that the police there are involved in killing civilians during the [[2021 Myanmar protests|ongoing protests]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/burma/kachin-independence-army-attacks-myanmar-regime-police-station.html (Irrawaddy)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Allied Democratic Forces|ADF]] gunmen attack a village in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], killing at least 23 civilians. Two attackers are shot dead by responding security forces. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/31/suspected-adf-militia-kill-23-in-new-eastern-dr-congo-massacre (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]]
**[[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] accuses [[Ukraine]] of "provoking armed confrontation" with [[Donbass separatists|pro-Russian separatist]]s in the war-torn eastern portion of the country. Putin also said that Ukraine failed to comply with the July 2020 [[ceasefire]] of the conflict, which has killed over 14,000 people since it broke out in 2014. [https://news.yahoo.com/putin-accuses-ukraine-provoking-clashes-085755024.html (Reuters via ''Yahoo! News'')]
*[[2021 Nigerien coup d'état attempt]]
**Gunfire erupts in the streets of [[Niamey]], [[Niger]], during an attempted [[coup d'état]] by [[Niger Armed Forces|soldiers]]. The coup was foiled and the perpetrators were arrested. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210331-soldiers-arrested-in-niger-after-attempted-coup (France 24)]
*[[Indonesian National Police headquarters shooting]]
**A woman opens fire at the [[Indonesian National Police]] [[headquarters]] in [[Jakarta]] before being shot dead by police. A male accomplice flees the scene. No other casualties are reported. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/31/gunfire-heard-at-indonesian-national-police-hq-in-jakarta (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Bulgaria]] reports a record 5,176 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 338,426. [https://bnt.bg/news/coronavirus-in-bulgaria-daily-cases-exceed-5000-for-first-time-293693news.html (Bulgarian National Television)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces the extension of the "light [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]]" to the rest of the [[France|country]], which includes a school closure from April 12 to April 26, a one-month domestic travel ban, and closure of non-essential businesses beginning April 3 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/frances-macron-under-fire-for-pandemic-strategy-weighs-tougher-lockdown-11617202598 (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-56597319 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****The [[Federal Service for Veterinary and Phytosanitary Supervision (Russia)|Rosselkhoznadzor]] approves the Carnivac-Cov, which is the world's first [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for nonhuman animals. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/russia-registers-world-s-first-covid-19-vaccine-animals-n1262595 (NBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 407 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 32,825. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-11226-new-cases-record-407-new-deaths-18668-new-vaccinations.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] reports a record 5,358 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 611,295. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/health/coronavirus/2021/03/31/covid-bangladesh-records-highest-daily-caseload-ever (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan]]
****[[Jordan]] reports a record 111 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 6,858. [https://en.royanews.tv/news/26645/2021-03-31 (Roya News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] receives 600,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] from [[China]]. Vaccination of Chinese nationals could commence first as the Medicines Regulatory Authority says that the vaccination of Sri Lankans will begin after a study by a committee of experts. [https://www.lankabusinessonline.com/srilankan-airlines-transports-first-batch-of-sinopharm-vaccines-president-receives-stock/ (Lanka Business Online)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
****Restrictions temporarily increase in towns surrounding [[Byron Bay, New South Wales]], after people linked to a recent outbreak of the UK variant in [[Brisbane]] spread the virus. Mask wearing is made mandatory indoors and private gatherings are limited to 30. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/mar/31/covid-19-nsw-hotspots-list-regional-sydney-coronavirus-case-outbreak-locations (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tonga]]
****[[Tonga]] receives its first shipment of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] supplied through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://matangitonga.to/2021/03/31/first-batch-covid-19-vaccine-arrives-tonga (Matangi Tonga)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***For the second consecutive day, [[Brazil]] reports a record total of 3,950 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] from COVID-19 in the last 24 hours, thereby bringing the number of deaths to 321,515. The total of 66,868 deaths in the past 31 days marked the most lethal month in the country for the duration of the pandemic. [https://g1.globo.com/jornal-nacional/noticia/2021/03/31/brasil-bate-novo-recorde-de-mortes-por-covid-em-24-horas-3950.ghtml (G1)]
***Brazil's health regulator [[Anvisa]] approves the emergency use of the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://brazilian.report/coronavirus-brazil-live-blog/2021/03/31/emergency-johnson-vaccine/ (''The Brazilian Report'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Philippines relations]], [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Philippines]] says that a [[China|Chinese]] maritime fleet "manned by [[militia]]s" have now spread to wider areas inside its [[exclusive economic zone]] after occupying the disputed [[Whitsun Reef]], and defying its demands for the [[flotilla]] to be withdrawn from its waters. Chinese diplomats say that the boats were sheltering from rough seas and denies the involvement of militias. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-china-southchinasea/philippines-says-chinese-militia-swarm-has-spread-in-disputed-waters-idUSKBN2BN0ZS?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar–United States relations]], [[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**The [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]] orders all "non-emergency" diplomats and their families to leave [[Myanmar]] amid worsening violence in the country. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20210330-us-orders-its-non-essential-diplomats-to-leave-myanmar-as-situation-worsens (France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Orange, California office shooting]]
**At least four people are killed and another injured during a [[mass shooting]] at an office building in [[Orange, California|Orange]], [[California]], [[United States]]. The attacker is shot and wounded by responding security forces. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/03/31/us/orange-california-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Far-right terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**A young man, 16, from [[Newcastle upon Tyne|Newcastle]], receives a non-custodial sentence after admitting to inviting support for banned neo-Nazi terror group [[National Action (UK)|National Action]], plus multiple offences of inciting terrorism and stirring up racial hatred. The young man, who founded his own neo-Nazi cell at the age of 15, is the third-youngest UK terror convict. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-tyne-56577064 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Dutch general election]]
**The new [[List of members of the House of Representatives of the Netherlands, 2021–present|members]] of the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]] are installed by [[Speaker of the House of Representatives (Netherlands)|Speaker]] [[Khadija Arib]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2374860-nieuwe-tweede-kamer-in-drie-etappes-beedigd.html (NOS)]
*[[1973 Chilean coup d'état]]
**Newly declassified documents released by the [[National Security Archive|US National Security Archive]] shows that [[Brazil]] supported the [[coup d'état]] that overthrew [[President of Chile|Chilean President]] [[Salvador Allende]], and raised power to dictator [[Augusto Pinochet]]. [https://riotimesonline.com/brazil-news/brazil/brazil-helped-raise-chiles-dictator-pinochet-to-power-according-to-declassified-us-documents/ (''The Rio Times'')]
